notes.title: Update 1.1.4: Controller Support and Scorekeeping
notes.content:
Just upfront: this is [i]not[/i] this year's content update. More on that later. For this update I focused mainly on bug fixes, improvements and adding a few new features, such as [b]FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/b]. 🎉

When I released this game two years ago, I never expected controller support to be the most requested feature (since it’s a shooter for PC and all), but here it is—it’s finally in the game! Please let me know how it works for you. I had some people playtest it here in Berlin at Games Ground last month, and the feedback was generally positive.

Another requested feature that’s now included in this update is [b]scorekeeping[/b]. Whenever you finish a run, you’ll now see your previous best results (from this point onward—unfortunately, stats from runs before the update can't be retrieved). Additionally, you’ll now have the option to restart the level directly without needing to return to the menu.

As for the content update: yes, I’m working on it! Finalizing the controller support took much longer than I anticipated, but I’m still aiming to release the new level in time for Christmas. Fingers crossed! 🎅

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] In-game achievements now properly reset if they weren't registered by Steam
[*] Fixed the snowman circle achievement mistakenly triggering
[*] Boss corpses no longer draw some of the skill effects
[*] Improved font quality and went over the localization again

[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Star Mode Improvement[/b]: Kills during Star Mode now extend its duration. Collecting another star while in Star Mode fills the meter completely. Zombies no longer despawn during Star Mode.
[*] Improved the item spawn system from presents
[*] Shortened spawn sequence of zombies to avoid the player running into them
[*] Tree shaders use dithering now to avoid clipping the camera
[*] Increased size of presents to make them easier to target
[*] Enlarged boar warning indicator
[*] Expanded the headshot hitbox area.
[*] Overhauled menus to ensure smooth controller functionality
[*] Damage numbers now overlay enemies instead of being hidden.
[*] Reduced HP for standard zombies to balance gameplay.

[/list]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Full controller support[/b] - tested with an Xbox One controller
[*] Score sheet at the end of each run now displays personal bests for all categories (Time, Levels, Kills, Coins) and saves them.
[*] Added buttons at the end of the score screen to either restart the level immediately or go directly to the Christmas skill tree.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Another update with a lot of fixes. Shattering finally doesn't cause any lag spikes anymore and also a bunch of other things have been cleaned up around the freeze mechanic. Also I'm trying out a new option for players that have been struggling with the zoomed-in over-the-shoulder aiming setup. You can now press C and the aiming view will switch between the default one and a new centered view that gives more overview to the surroundings to avoid ambushes easier. Hope it helps.
Also I changed some things with the default shotgun. To make it more appealing again it starts with 3 projectiles now.

I wish everyone a happy new year 2024!

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed performance bottleneck when enemies were shattering from the [i]Ice Bucket of Dread[/i] skill card
[*] Mammoths don't slide anymore after freezing and execute the run animation properly
[*] Improved mammoth's freeze animation
[*] Fixed bug that caused frozen enemies to slide towards the player after spawning
[*] Fixed coins being rewarded for the first level the character starts with
[*] Fixed boss behavior that caused them to never attack when the player stayed too far away
[*] Removed placeholder item and skill cards from the deck that aren't unlockable yet
[*] Fixed bug that could stop shields from spawning again in the level
[*] Gems from shattering Undead Vultures drop to the floor now
[*] Cleaned up explosives from respawning enemies like boars, vultures and mammoths
[*] Boars, vultures and mammoths also start the projectile bounce from the Light Chain skill card
[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reverted change from 1.1.0 that divided coins for time survived by 3. Now the reward is back to 1 second equals 1 coin to improve pacing of progress.
[*] Minigun base damage reduced to 30 for balancing
[*] Ducks and Stars don't spawn from presents within the first 90 seconds anymore when they were not as useful
[/list]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the [b]option to switch the aim camera view[/b] between classic over-the-shoulder and a new centered view
[*] More of a change than something new, but I just wanted to highlight it here: The [b]shotgun starts with 3 projectiles now[/b] that have a combined base damage of 90 (30 per projectile), which also means the total number of projectiles it can get to with the [i]Caramel Liqueur[/i] skill card has been raised to 11.
[/list]

notes.title: Festive update 1.1 is out!
notes.content:
It's been 1 year to the day of the initial release of Xmas Apocalypse, and it's quite a joy to still see new players and returning ones having fun with the game. 

So today is the day for the first annual major update! The[b] minigun from the cover is finally in the game[/b]! Also [b]Steam Achievements[/b] have been added!  A [b]new skill[/b] was added to the tree! Santa's niece is a [b]new unlockable character[/b]! There are several [b]new enemy types[/b], and a [b]new mini boss[/b]. The Icy Forest level [b]playtime has been doubled [/b]. I have also put in the foundation to be able to add more maps in the future, but I will make further announcements once it comes to that.

Also [b]Cloud Saving[/b] is supported now and with that everyone's [b]saves will be reset[/b], which is also needed because of the achievements. But if there was ever a time to start this game again, it should be now. 

I have added localization for[b] 10 additional languages[/b] for the game which took way more time than I anticipated! Please let me know if you come across any mistakes or anything that looks off.

I really hope you enjoy the update, I will continue working on more for the next couple weeks. Let me know if you have any feedback either in the discussions or on [url=http://discord.gypynkt.com]discord[/url]!

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bullets spawn correctly now when the fire rate is high (no more bullet stuttering with the nailgun)
[*] Enemies that run away (especially boars) can be hit from behind now
[*] Fixed various performance bottle necks regarding collision detection, pooling, garbage collection and animation culling
[*] Fixed head bobbing glitch when aiming
[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 10 more minutes to the Icy Forest map making it now 20 minutes to complete
[*] Removed the critical chance mechanic. Hitting the weak points will now always do critical damage.
[*] Adjusted the critical damage of weapons accordingly for balance and moved the Mistletoe of Misery skill card from the tree to the default cards
[*] Increased damage scaling of the following skills: Pain Cones, Burning Wreath, Donner & Blitzen, Slaying Bell
[*] Adjusted effective range of weapons and increased the falloff range
[*] Explosions and boars deal a numerical damage now instead of killing whatever they can kill immediately.
[*] More reactive voicelines from Santa depending on how the enemy died (default, burn, explosion, shatter) with the option to reduce the frequency or turn them off completely.
[*] Made the available nodes on the skill tree more visible
[*] Added an option in the selection menu for picking different maps in the future
[*] Not defeating a boss within the time limit will cause a shockwave as they despawn and damage the player
[*] Defeating a boss within the time limit will also drop a bunch of XP
[*] Pressing dash during aiming cancels the aim state now for faster reaction
[*] Weapon reload triggered immediately after the last shot in magazine
[*] Reload key bound to R (E still works for reload as well)

[/list]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Over 50 [b]Steam Achievements!!![/b]
[*] Cloud Saving (confirmed to work with Steam Deck)
[*] Added support for [b]10 additional languages[/b]: French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese
[*] New unlockable weapon: the [b]Minigun!!!![/b] It's finally in the game and not just on the cover!
[*] New unlockable skill: [b]Nuclear Snow Globe[/b] - plant sticky bombs on enemies
[*] New unlockable character: [b]Mary[/b] - starts with the Slaying Bell skill card
[*] New stat for characters: [b]Gold rate[/b] - determines how many coins a character can get from presents
[*] New button when leveling up to [b]reshuffle cards[/b] in case you didn't get what you wanted. The first one is free but after that the price increases with every time used.
[*] New enemy: [b]Undead Vulture[/b] - spawns when you leave items from presents laying around unattended.
[*] New enemy: [b]Tree Imp[/b] - supports the Frosty Elder Tree
[*] New enemy: [b]Mammoth[/b] - huge end phase version of the boar
[*] New enemy: [b]Hellguard[/b] - beefy devils that perform sudden sprints to grab you.
[*] New boss: [b]Horny Demon[/b] - summons goat skulls and teleports

[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0 coming in November
notes.content:
It's getting closer to the end of the year, and I am starting to look at what to improve on Xmas Apocalypse. Since it's an extremely seasonal game my general idea was that I would provide new content every coming year, but for this year I want to do something bigger and overhaul a lot of the gameplay mechanics based on feedback that you have given me after release!

Everything I list after this are things that I want to be in the game, I cannot promise that they will be immediately in the  [b]1.1.0 Update in November[/b], but it is my intention to add all of this as I further develop the game. Any comments or suggestions that you have, please reply to this post or to the pinned Suggestions discussion.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
I want to implement different weapon handling and controls for each weapon, and also extend the list of weapons available. The plan is to make each weapon to feel unique and not just be a different version of the shotgun. Right now I'm considering to add a mini-gun and a grenade launcher, but I'm open to hear suggestions.

[h3]More enemies and a new map[/h3]
I want to extend the duration of the current level beyond the 10 min mark. For that it needs more enemy variety and a few more bosses. Also I want to implement a second map with unique enemies to add a bit more variety.

[h3]New player characters[/h3]
I'm looking forward to introduce new player characters to the game. I have some ideas that I will share at a later point. 🤖

[h3]Skip/shuffle or skill card refunds?[/h3]
One of the complaints in the reviews has been that purchased skill cards on the skill tree are not 'refundable'. In my opinion the thrill of the game comes from not knowing which upgrades you can get this round and sometimes being stuck with combinations that you didn't plan to have that can still work out well. Having full control over which upgrades you can get each round will just lead to the same builds again and again which is not really in the spirit of the game. I do see though that there can be a middle ground. Maybe that each character gets a further stat of how many times you could skip an upgrade selection during a run if you don't like any of the offered cards, or a second shuffle to have a chance at something else. Another idea would be to have a selection screen at the beginning of the round in which you could activate or deactivate all available skill cards which I am hesitant to do though for the previously mentioned reasons. Admittedly here I would love to get feedback from you guys! So please let me know what you think

[h3]General improvements to the game[/h3]
There are a lot of things that I want to have in the game that are more related to settings or the steam environment. Setting up some of these will [b]unfortunately require to wipe everyone's save files [/b]which I deeply regret having to do, but it will lead to a more future-proof game experience.
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Cloud Saves
[*] Controller Support
[*] Further languages beyond English (Suggestions? Japanese, German, etc?)
[/list]
Again I want to emphasize that it might take longer than November to get all of these things into the game, but I'll do my best!

Thank you for all the support so far!

notes.title: Content Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for being patient while the work on this beast of an update took way longer than I had anticipated. [b]3 new skills! 1 new character! 3 perks![/b] And a lot of fixes and changes to improve the game. 

I also fixed a couple things with the save system, which unfortunately resulted in the nailgun being locked again even when you had unlocked it previously. So if you already purchased it, I apologize that it has to get unlocked again. I have reduced the price a bit to make up for it. These changes were necessary for more weapons to be added in the future. 

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] removed dodge knockback on enemies still being triggered after death
[*] Vixen's corpse doesn't get pushed anymore
[*] Santa's backpack dropping when dying with Vixen
[*] Corrected round-off errors when increasing magazine size
[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] added particle and sounds effects to dodge roll
[*] improved vfx for shield
[*] extended the blast radius of explosive barrels
[*] Super star mode does damage to bosses now
[*] Enemy spawn behavior adjusted during reloads
[*] Glowing spheres on skill trees replaced with glowing ornament meshes
[*] Collection page for skills is scrollable now to fit all skill cards
[*] optimized saved data
[*] price for nailgun set to 850 coins
[*] Some enemies drop blue gems with more XP now
[*] Defeating the Elder Tree rewards bonus coins at the end of the run
[/list]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] New unlockable skill: [b]Dashing Snowball[/b] - dodge roll into enemies to injure them
[*] New unlockable skill: [b]Ice Bucket of Dread[/b] - freeze enemies when you shoot them
[*] New unlockable skill: [b]Pain Cones[/b] - orbiting pine cones that hurt
[*] New unlockable character: [b]Old Tree[/b] - Defeat the Frosty Elder Tree to play with this character
[*] New to unlock on the skill tree: PERKS - permanent stat bonuses at a higher but fixed price. The added perks are: [b]+1 skill slot, +1 max HP, +50% magazine size[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. Thank you so much for the amazing launch week! I didn't know what to expect exactly with this game, but the mostly positive response is really motivating. I have received so much feedback and ideas, I actually have to see what is possible for me to implement. This patch is the first update during this week. It is mostly taking care of bugs that I've been made aware of and adds a few smaller features. The next update will be more content focused. 

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed glitch on death when picking up health
[*] fixed hitbox turning back on during super star mode
[*] candy pick-up item doesn't get stuck in the air anymore
[*] level-up sound effect replaced and part of the SFX slider
[*] corrected IK error when switching between aiming and normal camera back and forth too quickly
[*] Steam Deck: buttons in select menu scale to fit
[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Super Star mode can kill boars
[*] Boars can drag the player along
[*] spawn points of enemies have been slightly adjusted
[*] updated the illustration of Light Chain skill
[*] added short invincibility period after level-up
[*] added control instructions to the loading screen
[/list]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] New default skill: Cinnamon Candle - attract nearby gems and items.
[*] New setting in option menu: Toggle screen shake
[/list]

Since it was so heavily requested I have already added the 'magnet' skill to the default skill cards to choose from at the beginning of each round. For now it is freely available, but at some point it might be locked behind an achievement. Let me know if you have any feedback!

gypynkt

notes.title: Xmas Apocalypse is available now!!
notes.content:
I am beyond excited to announce the release of Xmas Apocalypse, the festive horde-survival third-person-shooter is available on Steam and I heard people have been playing the game even on Steam Deck. So take your shotgun and give those zombies and other creatures lead. 

[h3]And there is more to come.[/h3]
Until Christmas, next to fixing any bugs that I may get reported, I plan to add as much content as I can:
[list]
[*] More skill cards
[*] more unlockable characters
[*] more weapons
[*] more pickup items
[*] more boss creatures and other enemies
[*] a longer night
[*] steam achievements and more
[/list]
What I prioritize is definitely up to player feedback, so  If you have any suggestions, don't hesitate to join the [url=https://discord.gypynkt.com]discord server [/url] or drop them in the discussion below! Thanks!

gypynkt
